card.title: PS5 RTC battery and clock circuit troubleshooting

source.title: PS5 RTC Battery and Clock Circuit Diagnostic

claims.statement: The battery powers the 32Khz oscillator for the southbridge.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing from the CR2032 battery to the southbridge area.

claims.statement: A high voltage drop across the 1k resistor indicates a short circuit or faulty southbridge.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing to the 1k resistor with text describing voltage drop implications.

cautions: If battery is empty, it may indicate a short circuit.
card.caveats: The image does not provide specific voltage values or expected resistance measurements for the 1k resistor.
